subject: mathematics
concept: Solving optimization problems using derivatives to find maximum or minimum values
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student physically tests different dimensions of a shape (e.g. a box) to find which maximizes or minimizes a quantity, then verifies using derivatives
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an optimization scenario to its correctly set up function to maximize or minimize
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world optimization problem using derivatives to find the maximum or minimum

misconception_flags: finds a critical point but doesn't verify whether it's a maximum, minimum, or neither

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
